notes.title: Poetry Tuber-V0.5 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
In this update, we've focused on enhancing text effects and the overall atmosphere.

For text effects: We currently offer three types - translation, diffusion, and random. The right use of these animations brings a touch of elegance to an otherwise plain desktop.

Foreground effects now include raindrops and drifting snow, adding more depth and mood to the poetry.

Considering feedback from users about the quality of the poetry voiceovers, we've tried adding over ten poems with real human voiceovers.

However, keeping in mind the cost of real human voiceovers, future poetry productions will primarily rely on AI fine-tuning.
